name: C.R. International Inc.
old_description: Providing our customers with quality electronic manufacturing services for over 40 years!
about:
C.R. International Inc., headquartered in Laurel, Maryland, was founded in 1981 as a small engineering firm supplying communications and data-processing equipment to federal customers. The company is a certified Woman-Owned Small Business and has remained independently owned since its inception.

Today CRI operates as a full-service electronic manufacturing services (EMS) provider. Its capabilities span printed circuit board assembly, surface-mount technology on two SMT lines equipped with DEK screen printers and Mycronic pick-and-place machines capable of placing 01005 components through large BGAs, conformal coating in acrylic, silicone, or epoxy, box-build and electro-mechanical integration, and functional testing. Production takes place in an 18,000-square-foot climate-controlled facility that supports prototype through volume runs.

The customer base includes military, aerospace and flight, communications, industrial, and Department of Defense programs, as well as start-ups. The company cites NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory and defense prime contractors as references, highlighting work on flight-certified hardware and mission-critical defense electronics.

CRI positions itself as a partner rather than a vendor, stressing flexibility, responsiveness, and a commitment to the highest standards of ethics and quality. Its quality system is built around IPC Class III workmanship, ITAR compliance, and CMMC Level 2 cybersecurity certification.
